name: AquaTru Shower Filter
description: AquaTru Shower - Advanced Shower Filter Removes Impurities from Hard Water to Support Healthy Skin, Scalp, Hair, Reduce Breakage, and Enhance Your Beauty and Self-Care Routine (Polished Chrome)
features: Help support Your Skin & Hair: Advanced 4-stage filtration effectively filters harsh chemicals from your shower water, leaving your skin & hair looking smooth and beautiful
4 Luxurious Stream Settings: Choose between Regular, Mist, Massage, or High-Pressure for a customized, spa-like experience
Third-Party Tested: 270g proprietary filtration material combines Copper-Zinc Alloy, Calcium Sulfite, & Catalytic Carbon for superior contaminant removal
Regenerative Filter Material: Provides 90 days (based on 8-minute showers for a single person) of pure water with consistently clean water for that span—not just on day one
Easy Filter Changes: Replace filters quickly & easily with our twist-lock design – no special tools needed
4 Premium Finishes: Choose from Brushed Nickel, Polished Chrome, Brushed Gold, or Matte Black to perfectly match your bathroom's style and decor
Effectively filters chlorine, chloramine, & other contaminants for cleaner shower water, your hair & skin will love

Designed to fit standard U.S. shower arms with 1/2" NPT connections—the most common size in American homes. Installation is simple - unscrew your old showerhead and attach the AquaTru Shower. No special tools or plumbing expertise needed
